speaker: penny
text: Okay, it's done. Look, guys, for the future, I don't mind killing the big spiders, but you have to at least try with the little ones.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Penny, please, we're facing a far more serious problem than stray arachnids.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, it's not that bad.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Not bad? It's horrible. I mean, you hear stories about this sort of thing, but you never think it'll happen to you.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: So they steamed your dumplings, get over it. New topic, please.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: All right, Penny, let me take this opportunity to point out that you are looking particularly ravishing today.

speaker: penny
text: Not with a thousand condoms, Howard.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: So, there is a number.

speaker: penny
text: Okay, new topic, please. Hey, did you hear the people upstairs in 5A are moving out?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Shh-shh-shh!

text: What?

text: The people upstairs are moving out.

text: No!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: The horror!

text: Why would you just say something like that?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, no, no, no, no, no, no...

text: How else was I supposed to say it?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Slowly, like putting a new fish in a tank. You don't just drop it in, you let the bag sit in the water a while.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: The horror!

speaker: penny
text: Sheldon, I'm sure it's going to be fine.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, it's not going to be fine, change is never fine. They say it is, but it's not.

speaker: penny
text: Okay, honey, did you even know the people that are moving out?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I never met them. That's what made them perfect, there were no awkward hellos in the halls, there was no clickety-clacking of high heel shoes on hardwood floors, they may as well have been a family of cats just jumping around from drape to drape without that annoying ammonia urine smell.

speaker: penny
text: Well, I'm sure the new people will be just as quiet.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You can't know that. How can you possibly know that?

speaker: penny
text: You're right, I can't. You know what? Anyone could rent that apartment now, an opera singer, the cast of stomp, yeah, a tap-dancing pirate with a wooden leg.

text: Why are you making it worse?

text: I tried making it better, he wouldn't go for it.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You're right, that's a great idea. I'll take the apartment upstairs. I can finally get away from my mother, and we can all spend some more time together, if you catch my drift.
